 Here's today's Final Jeopardy (in the category Place Name Meanings ) for Friday, November 20, 2026 (Season 43, Game 50) :
 In Ukranian, it means "wormwood", also the name of a star in Revelation that poisons 1/3 of the Earth's water & causes many to die 
 (correct response beneath the contestants)
 Today's Jeopardy! contestants:
 Carey Kennedy , a senior HR manager from Oswego, Illinois 
 Dave Cutler , a nonprofit manager from Portland, Oregon 
 Solomon Klein , an instructional designer from Toronto, Ontario, Canada 
 Solomon enters today's game as a 2-day champion with winnings of $50,000.
 Andy's Pregame Thoughts:
 Solomon Klein of Toronto, Ontario has won a pair of games with identical $25,000 scores; today, he goes for victory #3 against Dave Cutler of Portland, Oregon and Carey Kennedy of Oswego, Illinois. While Solomon does have a pair of runaway victories, I do think it's also pertinent to note that Solomon is just 2-for-4 on Daily Doubles; it's certainly possible that a Daily Double miss at the wrong time—especially as the Daily Double difficulty seems to be trending a few percentage points more difficult in Season 43 vice Season 42 —might prove to end a run sooner than many fans would like.
 For those of you who missed the news yesterday, a pair of news items dropped: firstly, the show is hosting its first ever fan convention , Jeopardy!Con , in Washington, D.C. from May 7-9, 2027. Secondly, the Second Chance field for January's event was announced. (Yesterday was presumably chosen for that announcement due to the fact that the three Second Chance weeks were taped on Monday through Wednesday of this week.)

 Correct response: What is Chernobyl? 
 More Information About Final Jeopardy!:
 (The following write-up is original content and is copyright 2026 The Jeopardy! Fan. It may not be copied without linked attribution back to this page.) 
 According to Wormwood Forest: A Natural History of Chernobyl , there are two very similar but slightly different plants, Artemisia absinthium (polyn) and Artemisia vulgaris (chornobyl). Per that same work, "botanically and chemically, Absinthium vulgaris is so similar to A. absinthium that A. vulgaris is also sometimes called “wormwood,” though “mugwort” is a more common English name. In Ukrainian, as well, polyn and chornobyl are sometimes used synonymously." However, in the aftermath of the Chernobyl nuclear disaster in 1986, those with Ukranian-language Bibles—rare in the officially atheist Soviet Union—noted that the Wormwood star referenced in Revelation 8:11 was translated as "polyn", the very close botanical cousin to "chornobyl". This, of course, led many to believe that the Chornobyl nuclear disaster had been Biblically prophesied.
 Regardless of how today's Final Jeopardy played in terms of difficulty, I left this clue feeling like I learned something!
 Game Recap:
 One of the best games of the season to date saw Dave Cutler successfully convert a $10,000 Daily Double late in the Double Jeopardy Round, ensuring that Solomon Klein's third game wasn't a runaway entering Final Jeopardy.
 Final Jeopardy today was a Triple Stumper, which would ordinarily mean advantage Dave. But Dave wagered way too much, and that makes Solomon a 3-day champion. He'll go for win #4 on Monday.

 Final Jeopardy! wagering suggestions:
 (Scores: Solomon $32,000 Dave $23,000 Carey $3,800) 
 Solomon: Standard cover bet today is $14,001. If you are certain that Dave is going to bet less than $5,000, then you might be able to maneuver against that by betting between $2 and $3,998. (Actual bet: $18,000) 
 Dave: For the best chance of winning today, bet no more than $4,999 and take victory if Solomon is incorrect and makes the standard cover wager. (Actual bet: $15,399) 
 Carey: You need two huge overbets to have any chance. Bet whatever you like. (Actual bet: $3,700)
